text: 金融监管总局：稳妥推进中小金融机构改革化险、减量提质，积极支持配合化解房地产和地方政府债务风险
text_en: National Financial Regulatory Administration: Steadily advance the reform, risk resolution, reduction in number and quality improvement of small and medium-sized financial institutions, and actively support and cooperate in resolving risks in real estate and local government debt
